systems.name: 3.1 Host‑Authority Stabilisation
systems.notes: Resolve all known netcode footguns: kill‑feed dedup, player index sort instability, remote player attack sync, pillar position sync.
tasks: Fix kill‑feed dedup using sequence numbers, not reference equality
Stable player indices (use player join order, not Object.keys sort)
Sync remote player attack state for animation
Consolidate PILLAR_POSITIONS to single source of truth

systems.name: 3.2 Reconnection & Host Migration
systems.notes: Allow players who disconnect to rejoin and recover their state. If host leaves, the next best player takes over seamlessly.
tasks: Serialise game state for rejoining players
Host migration handshake and state transfer
Rejoin grace period and spectator mode

systems.name: 3.3 Remote Entity Interpolation
systems.notes: Smooth out remote player and enemy movement by interpolating between state updates instead of snapping.
tasks: Client‑side interpolation for remote player positions
Smooth enemy movement by lerping between host snapshots
